name: Yamaha TZR250
engine: 249 cc liquid-cooled two-stroke twin, power valve
intro: A small two-stroke sport bike from Japan with race-bike looks. Several engine layouts over the years.

G: Check the oil injection: the tank feeds the pump, the lines are bled, and the pump cable opens with the throttle.
A: Many of these are imports. Make sure the title and VIN paperwork match before you put money in.

recallNote: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start. Recalls on these models change over time.
